tei:div.tei:p: (1na)zla 'od gzhon nus mdzad pa'i bcud bsdus bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// oṃ ma hā gu ru hūm̐/ bcud len dam pa rnams la na mo// phyag rgya chen po sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bcud len mang yang phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ phyi'i bcud len ni/ ra sa yā na la brten te/ bsgrub pa'o// ra sa yā na ni rgya bod kyi sman 'gyur tshad la bya'o// nang gi bcud len ni bdud rtsi lnga'o// gsang ba'i bcud len ni lta sgom spyod gsum mo// yi ge'i bcud len ni oṃ āḥhūṃ la bya'o// nang gi sgrub pa la rgyal po ltar sgrub pa/ drang srong ltar sgrub pa/ dmangs ltar sgrub pa'o// drang srong dang rgyal po bsdebs/ bu chung dang dmangs su bsdebs/ drang srong ni bla ma la brten/ bla ma ni dge slong ma tshwa mi za ba srung sdom la gnas pa/ las rgya mi rten pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni yod na 'bras la bya/ med na nas dkar mo'i byed lugs bye brngos kyis dkar shig la btang*/ dkar shig mgo ser tsam du brngos la zhib par btags/ bla ma nad bu med pa shes rab che ba/ (2na)rigs btsun pa gzhon dar la bab pas gsol te/ bdud rtsi mar phul do chu phul gang du btsos tsa na/ skyabs blangs pas me la bzhag pas tshig na ma tshos pa yin/ zangs su mi btso phru bar btso/ de zhun mar srang gcig dang bdud rtsi srang gnyis/ a ru ra gser mdog can gyi chur sbangs pa grib skams bya/ de nas 'o mas sbyangs/ skams shing skams pa de btags la yang gdab/ bzang drug gla rtsi ga bur tsandan dkar dmar tsha ba gsum/ rtsa ba lnga/ spru ba'i lo ma/ mtshe'i khaṇḍa/ shugs pa'i khaṇḍa/ bu ram sbrang rtsi/ cong zhi btul la bya'o// cong zhi btul ba srang gcig /'o ma srang gnyis/ sings kyis skams la sman rnams dus gcig tu bcos/ pho ba na ril gyis byung na sman ma zhu ba yin pas dri chu gdus la btang*/ bdud rtsi mkhris pa'i nang du lhung na kha dog ser por 'gyur te/ bcos thabs la 'bras bu gsum tig ta ba le ka

/ba sha ka'i thang btang*/ (2ba)gzhan yang bdud rtsi dang gong gi sman rnams sbyar nas btang na mkhris pa'i nad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bad kan gyi nang du lhung na gnyid med/ mig mi gsal/ khong skyug bro/ zas za snying mi 'dod/ de la tshil chen 'bras bu gsum bdud rtsi dang sbyar nas btang na/ snying rlung gi nad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bdud rtsi se rgod kyi bar shun dang spang rtsi ka ra dkar po/ yang na khye'u skyes pa ro tshan gyi chu dkar po/ dmog ma bya'i sha ba ya shu skyes pa'i ro tshan/ ga bur bzang drug skyer pa'i bar shun/ so phag phye ma/ tsan dan dkar dmar dang bo nga dkar po/ par ba ta bsil sman 'byor tshad/ bsre ru bre gu/ gser thig sro lo dkar po/ brag zhun utpal sngon po/ sngon 'gro a ru ra'i thang btang*/ 'di yi phan yon ni dug nad thams cad/ khrag nad rims nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bdud rtsi gos su gon pa dang*/ rta ru zhon pa dang*/ zas su za ba'o// gos su gon pa ni gtum mo'i me 'bar ma zhes kyang bya/ grang ba thams cad 'joms par tsha ba gsum/ mi'i mkhris pa/ mar bdud rtsi cha bsnyams te/ zla ba dgu'i bar du mnan nas ra'i ril ma tsam re zos na grang ba sel te drod skye'o// des drod ma skyes na mthe bong tsam za/ des ma zhu ba dang grang nad thams cad sel lo// rta ru zhon pa ni ru rta srang bcu drug /bdud rtsi srang drug cu rtsa bzhi mar dang cha mnyam par bya/ sbrang dang ru rta mnyam/ 'bras bu gsum dang bzang drug mnyam/ de rnams sbyar la zla ba dgu mnan nas ltor zos na/ bdud rtsi rta ru zhon pa zhes bya ste/ rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// gos su gon pa ni tsan dan dkar dmar/ bzang (3na)drug gla rtsi ga pur dang*/ spos su 'ong ba'i dri zhim sna tshogs kyis lus la byug des gos su bgo ba'o// bdud rtsi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste// bdud rtsi brten pas rnam snang gi sku thob// sgom sgrub sngags dang thos bsam bya mi dgos// dang du blangs shing zos pas byang chub 'thob// mnyam nyid stong pa ngang gis rtogs par 'gyur// byin rlabs cho 'phrul shugs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur// ma bslabs bstan bcos rnams kyang shes par 'gyur// theg pa sna tshogs chos la mkhas par 'gyur// ma bslabs sman dang bon yang shes par 'gyur// thams cad mnyam nyid phyogs ris med par shes shing*/

khong du chud par 'gyur/ bde stong 'dzin pa med par 'char te bdud rtsi'i sgom pa'o// thams cad shongs shing yangs pa bdud rtsi'i spyod pa'o// thams cad lhun gyis grub pa rang byung chen por 'dug pas bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu'o// nus pa phyogs bcur 'char bas bdud rtsi'i phrin las so// nyams myong thams cad kyi rtsa ba rlung yin te/ nyams myong khar mi btang ste rtsod pa mi bya'o// theg pa'i khar mi btang ste chos la skur pa mi 'debs so// chos thams cad kha kha nas bden/ dge sdig la shan mi dbye'o// gang zhig mtshams med pa byed pa la yang skur pa mi btab bo// rjes su yi rang ba mi 'bul/ gzhi ma bcos pa la lhod de shig ge bzhag /des na rlung thams cad la phan pas na bdud rtsi nyams su myong ba'i rlung ye shes su bsgyur bas na bdud rtsi'o// des na bdud rtsi la nan tan bya'o// stobs glang chen seng ge dang 'dra/ mdog ni zla ba nya ba 'dra/ lus ni sra ste rdo rje bzhin du brtan/ ngag ni thogs med byin rlabs 'byung*/ sems (3ba)ni stong gsal rgyun du bde/ dag pa gsum 'byung ste/ lus kyi dri ma 'dag /lus la srin bu mi gnas/ 'tsho ba la ched du mi gnyer bas sgrib pa mi bsag go /grol ba gsum 'byung*/ lus sprul sku/ sems chos sku/ ngag grags stong du grol/ oṃ bdud rtsi'i ṭī ka bstan pa la/ dang po sbyar ba'i thabs la mkhas par bya/ yo byad yod na bdud rtsi 'o ma mnyam/ ma long na 'o ma phul gang la mar gsar sgo nga tsam btab la lhag gis khol ba de bdud rtsi bre gang gi nang du blug /tshod par dkrug /de nas zhag gsum mam drug lon nas/ kha tsha lam me ba 'ong ste chu la btab la btung ngo*// nye dkar la lto ba sbyar chur ba bya mo'i sgo nga tsam chur mnan la khol ba de btung*/ de yang ma rnyed na co ga'i sgo nga tsam chu phul gang lhag gis khol ba la btab ste/ de a mṛ ta bre gang la sbyar la/

mchod par byas la zhag gsum mnan/ langs pa de mang du 'ong bas bkol la btung*/ khrag skam khyim bya'i sgo nga tsam/ chus sbyangs la dkrugs la bzhag ste/ bangs pa dang a mṛ ta bre gang du sbyar la/ mnan la bzhag /thams cad yod nas 'byor na bzang*/ sgog skya lpags pa bshus pa yang shis/ sman rnams mi bskol/ bdud rtsi mang na mar khur btul la btung*/ bdud rtsi'i khu ba bya sgong re dang*/ zhun mar ngang mo'i sgo nga tsam pa lnga dang sbyar la/ gong gi snum la mthe bong tsam bza'/ spyir yang bdud rtsi 'o ma'i nang du btsos la btung*/ skyug log ge byas zas ma 'dod nas lus sbo ba dang gnyid med pa dang*/ skrangs pa dang de rnams rlung las gyur te chu phul bdun la/ zhun (4na)mar phul phyed/ 'o ma phul gang bsdus la/ phul gsum song ba btung ste de yang rlung nad sel bar byed do// nye'u shing grib ma la skyes pa de legs par bshus la/ grib skam byas pa zhib par btags la 'o mas kha phru btab/ 'o mas chu byas la mar khu bzhin brtsags la/ spyin thang gis byung ba'i mar khu de sbrang dang sbyar la za/ gzhan gang yang sdeb tu btub pa'o// mkhas pa pad ma 'byung gnas kyi u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du sgom mnyam dka' thub bcud len nyams su blangs pas tshe'i dngos grub thob/ skal ldan bod kyi rje mnga' bdag rgyal po la/ 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba bskyungs la bcud len nyams su long*/ bsam yas dbu rtse byang ngos su bla mas gsungs pas rje rab tu dgyes te dbu thod bud bud phyag 'tshal nas zab thul padma can/ g.yu dung nyol gsung skad chog /gser bre drug phul nas bla ma la bdud rtsi'i phan yon ci mnga' zhus pas/ spyir bdud rtsi la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab/ sgom mi dgos nyams su blangs na rnal 'byor pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku 'thob/ thig le zos pas ye shes sems dpa'i sku/ padma rakta nyams su blangs pas snang ba mtha' yas sku 'thob/

sha chen dang du blangs pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sku 'thob/ dri dang du blangs pas don yod grub pa'i sku 'thob pa'o che ste/ sman dang ma sbyar te dri bsung dag dang ldan/ rtsi yi ma bskus te kha dog shin tu legs/ lugs su ma blugs te dbyibs su bcos pa med/ gsol dang ma sbyar te nus pa gsol dang mnyam/ dug rnams rdul rlog bcud dang ma sbyar te lus kyi zungs kyang bskyed/ (4ba)lha srin bran du 'khol/ mdze nad rab tu 'joms/ tshe ring nad med bu tsha rigs brgyud 'phel/ nor 'du/ nad rims mtha' dag 'joms/ dus 'di nyid kyi sa la lhun gyis grub/ rig 'dzin rtsal can rnams kyis kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug de la byin gyis rlobs/ lha mi yongs kyi phyag bya'i rten du 'gyur/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam nyams rnam smin las bzlog /bskal pa stong gis mtshams med lnga byas kyang*/ bdud rtsi chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ de kun mi gnas 'dag par 'gyur/ dper na nyi ma shar ba mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms/ gsang sngags dam nyams byang sems sdom nyams dang*/ nyan thos ltung ba la sogs bdud rtsis skongs/ de nas bdud rtsi za zhing spyod gang mi 'bab te/ nus pa gsol dang ldan/ bcud dang ma sbyar te lus kyi stobs bskyed/ ga bur rgyal po ste skom pa'i gdung ba sel/ rnal 'byor tsho yis btung zhing bkur bar bya/ zla drug zos pas mdze las thar bar byed/ lo re zos pas mthu chen thob par 'gyur/ zla ba bcu zos pas thos pa 'dzin par byed/ lo gsum las nor thams cad dbang du bsdus/ lo lnga zos na glang po'i stobs dang ldan/ seng ge'i stobs dang ldan/ mdog rma bya dang mtshungs/ zla ba nya ba bzhin ngo la dri ma mi chags/ lo drug zos na sa 'og sa steng gter rnams rnyed/ spyan rnam pa lnga 'char/ ye shes spyan dang ldan/ lo bdun zos pas bsad gso la sogs rdzu 'phrul shes/ lo brgyad ting 'dzin spobs pa sgyu rtsal phun tshogs/

dgu zos mi ldogs na gnas/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin thob/ bcu zos sangs (5na)rgyas byang sems bkod stobs phun sum tshogs/ bcu gsum zos yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la gnas/ phung po lhag ma med/ buddha thob par 'gyur/ ra sa yā na lo stong bsten pa bas/ bdud rtsi dag la mos pa bsod nams che/// /na mo gu ru/ bdud rtsi log gnon pa/ grang 'jams su song na chang la glad pa skams pa dang*/ bdud rtsi btab la btang*/ des ma chod na btsod rgya skyeg shing bsregs pa'i thal ba dang*/ sga pi pi ling chang la btab la btang*/ des 'bras tsha ba gsum rnal 'byor pa de'i dri chus zan dron byas la btang*/ sman gyi thun tshod rig pas bsnun/ gar ba thams cad zho tshad/ sla ba thams cad srang tshad btang*/ na mo/ bdud rtsi 'di la phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ gsang sgrub bla ma lang tsho dar la bab pa zhig la bsten/ de yang sha dang chang dang sgog btsong chang skyur me nyi ma spangs/ grib ma la bsdad/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis za tshe byin rlabs bya/ nang ltar sgrub pa bdud rtsi mar dang cha mnyam mu zi sbyor/ kha cig phyi sgrub zan dron byas la phabs btab cing legs par bcos pa bsnyal la btsags/ sigs ma phar 'phang*/ khu ba bdud rtsir sbyar/ bdud rtsi mar dang sbyar zan bya sgong tsam re lto stong la btang*/ tsha ba gsum mar rnying bdud rtsi dang sbyar/ bya sgong tsam res grang ba'i nad kun sel/ bdud rtsi ka ra bzang drug gangs chur sbyar/ gar sla lug zho tsam du dkrugs la btang*/ rims dang sha dug la sogs nad kun sel/ nas kar lpags bshus phyi zhib zan dron tshos/ bdud rtsi bsang nas bsgrub na (5ba)dngos grub 'byung*/ khrom chos byas na bar chod 'byung*/ gsungs pas na ba'am ma zhu na dri chu bar pa tsha ba btab bkol la btung*/ phyag rgya chen po tshe 'di nyid la 'thob/ dkar gsum mdog bsgyur/ mngar gsum ro bsgyur/ bzang drug la sogs sman rnams rnyed tshad btang*/// /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams ngag 'di la bzhed lugs lnga ste/

ri lu dang*/ 'gam phye dang*/ 'o skol dang*/ zan chang dang*/ mar khu'i man ngag go /de la dang po sngon 'gro ni/ na tshod thog mar lus stobs ldan// rtog dpyod dben pa rab tu bsten// drod tshad tsha skyur rul sungs spangs// sos dal nas dkar zan zos te// legs par rdo ba dag la bcar// ting lo lta bur legs skams te// slar brdung sa rang thag la sgral// rtsi bzhin btags pa'i nang du ni// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// 'bras bu gsum dang sbrang bu ram// a mṛ ta dang sbyar byas te// ri lu tshags byas snod bsags te// dgu bcu ci rigs za bar bya// za sgog tshwa dang rul sungs bsrung*// ngo cig sbyar ba'i sa phog za// zhes pa'o// de ni ri lu'i man ngag go /'gam phye'i sbyar thabs sngar ltar bya ba yin// bdud rtsi grib la legs par skams// brdungs te zhib par byas nas ni// sla ngar tsho bar bsres rjes la// sings po'am chu yi kha phru btab// rlangs pa thon bar bsos rjes la// mar khu yod na sbrang bu ram// rjen btags cung zad bran par bya// sgam bur legs par blugs byas te// sngon 'gro snga ma dag dang mtshungs// dngos gzhi bdud rtsi sum cha gcig /dang po snod du legs sbyar te// rlangs ma yol ba (6na)phye blug la// dri gsang ba yi gdams ngag yin// de dang mnyam pa'i mar bcug ste// phye ni phrus tsam sbyar byas nas// spa ra gsum sbyar zos byas na// lto mi 'khru zhing shed nyams che// dgu bdun dag la srin rnams thon// ltogs med skom pa cung zad la// chu bskol brten pa rab tu gces// spyir na dal ba gtso bor gces// de ni 'o skol bya thabs so// yang na sngon 'gro gong dang mtshungs// bdud rtsi rdza ma'i nang du ni// legs par chu 'jam dag la mnye// bskol bas skya ba'i rjes dag la// nar nar byung tshe phye blugs la// cung zad mar gyi dri gsod byed// zan dron tshal tshal en tsam pa// drod la brten byas tshangs par bya// phabs phyes bran te mnan byas la// zhag gsum dag na bslang bya ste// gci ba khu ba sngo dmar can// yid du 'ong zhing 'ju ba sla// thur mgo lnga gsum ci rigs za// dang ka bde la nad la byams// 'ju la sla zhing dri ma med// kha mi skom la bkrag mdangs gsal// de ni sbyor ba'i mchog yin no// de nas mar khu'i sbyor ba la// sngon 'gro mi dgos btsal ba'i thabs// sde snod 'dzin nam rnal 'byor pa// yang na mo gsar gzhon nu yis// bdud rtsi ji snyed skams byas te// rtswa dang sog ma ma yin pa'i// me la thab sreg man ngag bzhi// dam pa'i zhal las dri bar bya// de ltar bzhu ba'i mar khu de// bza' ba'i thabs dang tshad dag gis// zos na yon tan ji snyed pa// man ngag las byung 'di dag go

/zhag gcig la thun gsum du za ste/ tshad ni ril ma tsam du'o// yon tan lnga bcu rtsa bzhi ste/ 'chi 'phos nyen pa'am/ mdzes (6ba)nyen pa'am/ 'dres nyen pa'am/ las tshogs 'di rnams kyis phan gdags te/ de mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jug bcu las/ rnam snang rdzas dang sngags re dang*// bsgrub pa'i sbyor ba re re yis// mkha' 'gro'i las sbyor sbyor ba brgya// dngos grub bar chad sel ba'o// zhes pa'i man ngag ni/ mu zi btul ba ril ma tsam bzhi dang*/ bdud rtsi ril lu dang sbyar te/ sngags ha sa oṃ pa ti zhes zhag gcig gi bar du btab ste zos na klu rigs lnga'i mdze nad las thar bar 'gyur ro// yang bdud rtsi mu zi gu gul gsum sbyar/ oṃ me ra du sha na/ kro ti phaṭa/ sngags 'di lan gsum btab na/ dgag lhog skrangs pa'i nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// yang bdud rtsi sle tres dang shu dag /gla rtsi sbyar nas sngags tadya thā/ ho na lhun 'ju mdze swā hā/ zhag lngar btab nas lus la byugs shing zos na/ rims tsha ba'i nad las thar bar 'gyur ro// yang bdud rtsi lnga dang a ru ra tsan dan sbyar te/ oṃ ya ma tsag mo ha na mar song*/ sngags 'di zhag lnga btab nas zos sam mig la bkus na mig rab rib tu song ba'i nad las thar bar 'gyur ro// yang bdud rtsi dang mkhris pa sbyar ha sa ri oṃ swā hā/ zhag gcig tu btab nas zos shing byugs na zas skom gyi nad las thar bar 'gyur ro// yang bdud rtsi dang khyi lud khu ba dang*/ mkhris pa dang sbyar te oṃ khrag nyag raṃ song sngags 'di btab na sha dug las thar bar 'gyur ro// yang bdud rtsi dang*/ sman sga pho ba ri lu pi pi ling rnams sbyar te zhag bco lngar zos na grang ba'i nad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bad kan gyi gnas su lhung na skom dad che bas/ a ru ra (7na)mchu snyung zhig bca' sga gnyis bsdus pa'i thang btang*/ brang tsha zhing mgo 'khor na ma nu dang rgya tshwa/ shel tshwa dang sug smel se 'bru rnams yun du bsten no// mkhris pa'i nang du lhung nas/

mig ser ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang skyug log pa byung na/ ba sha ka dang ba le ka dang 'bras bu gsum gyi thang btang*/ tig ta gser gyi me tog gur gum/ li ga dur rnams ka ra la sbyar la btang ngo*// gos dro bar bya/ rab ni chu bskol dag la btang*/ zhes pas spyir ni chu bskol btang ba man ngag yin/ spyir dka' thub ces bya ba dka' ba thub pa la zer ba yin pas/ ji ltar byung yang byung rgyal du btang ba man ngag yin/ gal che'o gsung*/ snying rus skyed pa gal che/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ klu'i yul du chos bshad pas klu'i rgyal pos/ bcud len sbyor ba 'di phul lo// kye lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dman// tshe yi tshad kyang ma nges pas// dam pa'i chos kyang mi 'grub pas// tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin bsgrub// bcud len mang yang mdo don sman la thug /sman ni mang yang bsdus don gsum las med// sman sna mang yang dbang po'i lag la 'dus// mngar sna thams cad ka ra dag la 'dus// dkar sna thams cad 'o ma dag la 'dus// 'di la yon tan zad pa med pa sna tshogs yod// lo brgya thub pas brgyad brgya thub// dgu bcu lon pas bcu drug lon ltar 'ong*// skra dkar bud nas nag por 'gro// gnyer ma bud nas dkar por 'gro// nyams stobs glang chen lta bur (7ba)'gyur// yang zor seṅge lta bu'o// bang ni rtas kyang mi sleb bo// bkrag ni me tog padma 'dra// nyams stobs 'phel nas mchog tu 'ong*// gnod pa'i lha 'dre kun kyang gdong grogs byed// yon tan de dang ldan no gsung*// slob dpon gyis sbyar thabs dang*/ za thabs ji ltar lags dris pas/ sbyar thabs 'o ma bre do phul gang du gdu/ ka ra rdog po brgyad/ dbang po lag pa thun gnyis/ zhib par btags la 'o ma phog la der blugs la dkrug /drangs pa dang ga'u 'am snod du blugs la nad phyogs za/ zla ba phyed la zad par bya/

nyams ma 'phel na lan gsum bskyar ba'o// 'di nyid rtag tu spyad na tshe nyi zla dang mnyam// gdon dang rims dang 'byung ba rgud pa dang*/ lus rgud pa dang*/ nad 'du ba rnam bzhi las thar/ rgas pa dang na ba dang*/ rngul mi 'ong*/ tshe snga phyi dran la dus gsum shes/ dran pa gsal zhing lus yang bde/ 'phur shes mgyogs pa rlung dang 'dra/ rig 'dzin rnams dang mkha' 'gros gdong grogs byed/ lha srin thams cad grogs su byed/ bla ma yon tan zad pa med pa 'ong ngo gsung*/// /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byung ba rgyun gcod pa'i chos 'di byed pa la/ dang po skye shis 'jigs par byas la dug rnam pa lnga po la sogs pa/ sems la gnod pa'i bdud thams cad spangs la bya'o// gnas ni chu shing dang ldan pa'i dgon pa'am/ mi med pa'i dgon pa zhig byas la/ g.yeng bas mi 'khyer ba zhig byas na 'byongs bla'o// de nas dang po nas phul gang btsos la/ tshos tsa na snod gcig tu tshags bya'o// de nas tshes grangs (8na)bzang po tshes gcig nas bzung la bya ste/ de'i nub mo bla ma dang yi dam la gtor ma btang la/ de nas sngon la sgog pa btang ngo*// de nas dar zhig na chan spar gang za'o// de nas rang lhar bsgom par bya ste/ rang gi rig pa'i nang du bltas la/ srog rtsa la snying bkal nas yod pa'i snying gi dkyil na hūṃ zhig yod par bsgom/ de sems kyi sa bon yin no// de a ha sa la dub pa ho byas pas/ hūṃ de lha mor gyur nas lha mo sku mdog dkar la rgyan dang bcas pa/ padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas na gser gyi ral gri/ g.yon na bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phag mo dbu bcad ma'i gsang sgrub yin pas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma shin tu mdzes par bsgom mo// de nas sems la nyon mongs pa skyes tsa na/ rang gi g.yas kyi ral gris rang gi ske bcad par bsam mo// de nas rtsa'i sbubs dmar ram tse byung bas/

dug bsad par bsam/ dug lnga bsad nas ye shes lnga 'bar bas rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad bkra lam me bde bar yod par bsam/ de nas g.yon pa'i bum pa nas bdud rtsi'i chu rang gi rkan mar blugs pas/ rang gi ske 'byor ba dang*/ lus bdud rtsis khengs nas/ dkar mer gyis song nas zhim la 'grangs par bsam/ de'i rting la rlung bsgom par bya ste/ rlung dhū tir bcug la steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung 'then/ bar rlung skyil la rlung thub tshad bsdam/ de nas rlung de sna bug nas dkris la khad kyis gtong ngo*// de nas rang lha ru sgom zhing lha'i snying po sngags 'di/ oṃ badzra karma hri tā (8ba)a/ u pa de ba raksha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas sgom dang snying po'i byin rlabs kyis rang gi sems la ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'bar nas sangs rgyas par bsam/ de ltar bsgom zhing chu bskol tsha med nang nub tu btang ngo*// de nas zhag bdun ltogs par byung na/ sgog pa a ru ra/ shin kun gsum mar la sbyar la lus byug pa dang ltor btang bas srin thub bo// de nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig na rlung skyes pa byung na/ rus khu la tshwa btab pa la btung ba dang*/ lus la mar gyis byug pa byas pas rlung thub bo// de nas ma 'byongs kyi bar du skyon byung na log gnon 'di byas pas chog go /dang ga 'gags na a ru ra btang*/ rtsib mar zug na lus la mar byug /dri ma ma thon na mar kham cig btang*/ gsus pa dang rgyu ma 'byar na rlung bsgom/ sna 'gags na sha gsur btang*/ lus 'dar ba dang nyam chung na lus po chus bkrus la snum nyed yang yang bya'o// de ltar zla ba gcig tu bskyed rim de yang yang bsgom zhing*/ chan spar re gsum yar du za'o// gzhi 'dzin pa chan dang sgom pa yin/ 'byung ba ro snyoms pa la a ru ra dang*/ sgog skya shin khun mar yin pas/ de ltar tshags bya dgos so// mkha' 'gro ma'i chos 'di byed pa la/ dus gsum du gtor ma gal che ste 'di yin bya ba med do// 'byung ba rgyun gcod pa la gsum/

phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ phyi 'byung ba rgyun chad pa'i rtags ni/ lus dkar ba dang*/ yang ba dang bde ba 'byung ngo*// dbang po gsal ba dang*/ zas mi dgos pa 'byung ngo*// nang zhen pa chod pa'i rtags ni/ phyi'i rnam rtog spangs nas mngon par shes pa 'char ba dang*/ rlung zin pas zas mi dgos pa yang (9na)'byung ngo*// gsang ba nyon mongs pa rgyun chod pa'i rtags ni/ spyod pa chos dang ma bral bas nyon mongs pa dug lnga rang zhi/ sgom pa bying rmugs med pas de la nyams su myong*/ don gyi lta ba rtogs pas 'khor 'das gnyis su med/ de ltar rang la 'byung ngo*// chos 'di la brten nas de ltar yod do// stobs seng ge dang 'dra/ yang sha bya dang 'dra/ tshe nyi zla dang 'dra/ mgyogs pa rta dang 'dra/ lus me tog dang 'dra/ gzhon pa bu chung lta bu/ yon tan 'di tsho yang yin/ na tsha sdug bsngal mi 'ong ba/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal mthong ba/ skra dkar nag por 'gro ba/ nor rdzas la blo log pa/ gnyid mi 'ong ba/ dri mi 'ong ba lha dang mnyam pa/ ngag la nus pa thon pa/ lus la bde ba 'byung ba/ sems la rtogs pa skye ba/ dgra dang gnyen gnyis mnyam pa de ltar gyi rtags 'byung ngo*// chos 'di'i brgyud pa ni 'di ltar lags so// rgya gar gyi rje btsun dur khrod chen po bya bas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal bya bar phag mo bsgoms pas/ khong rgyags chad nas nang par khyim du rgyags len du 'gro dgos bsam pa la/ de'i nub mo chos 'di phag mo dkar mos lung bstan/ der khong gis 'bras rdog po gcig bcud len byas pas zla ba gsum na 'byongs nas/ mngon par shes pa shar ba dang*/ rtags de tsho shar ba lags so// de mkha' 'gro ma gcer bu ma la gnang*/ des bram ze mi rigs la/ des bal po dza la/ des skal ldan chen po la/ des bun po la/ de'i rdo rje la/ des bdag la gnang ba'o// 'gal ba byung na mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par (9ba)gsol/// /na mo gu ru/

chu'i bcud len la/ mar gyi zhun mar tshal pa cig dang*/ tsha ba gsum/ tshwa en cig /nas phye cig /mi la sogs pa'i rus pa rnyed tshad dang*/ zangs min pa'i snod ci rigs cig tshags byas la/ grub na bshal skyugs bya'o// chu gtor la sogs pa tshogs gsog grub tshad bya/ lus la byugs pa bya/ do nub lto cung zad zos la/ de nas rtsam pa gcod/ zhogs pa lce chung gi rtsa ba 'jibs pas/ nu sor lta bu gnyis nas byang sems dkar dmar 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu babs pas/ lus kyi rtsa sbubs thams cad gang bar bsam mo// mchil ma la sogs pa lan bcu gcig tsam du mid do// rtsa sbubs snying po de gang bas yon tan dpag tu med pa yod do// de nas chu bre phyed tsam pa zhig la tshwa dang phye ka en re gdab/ lhag gi khol na de phog la ngang yal gzhug go /de la srin lag gis oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum bkod la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsir bsams te btung ngo*// nyin mo dang dgong mo yang de bzhin du bya'o// chu'i dus la nges pa med/ chu la yog thang du btung ngo*// de nas mgo 'thoms pa dang rlung skyes na/ chu la rus pa gdab/ chu'i gong du mar dum re btang ngo*// tsha ba grang ba yul dang sbyar/ srin rdog po yang 'byung ngo*// der lus yang du 'gro/ sha skye/ shes pa gsal/ zhag bcu drug chu bdun nas chu grang la phye en re btab la btung ngo*// nam ltogs pa na btang ngo*// zla ba gcig na 'byongs so// dam tshig me nyi ma drag brdal/ (10na)gtan mang po/ bud med spang*/ en re lus bcag /'o ma dang chang dang po nas btung yang legs/ 'byongs nas dag brdal mi bya/ gnyid chung khams bzang*/ dal ba mi yong*/ dgra bgegs dang nad dang gnyer ma mi yong*/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob bo// bla ma bai ro'i gdams pa 'go ba'i nad thams cad thub bo/// /bla ma rnams la na mo/

chu grang 'thung gi man ngag la/ a ru ra lnga tsam/ mu zi dkar po/ tshwa bzang po/ sgog skya shun pa bshus pa/ bur rnying ngam/ de med na sbu bur/ de rnams a ru ra tsam re bsre'o// dang po yibs rus sna tshogs kyis a ru ra btsos/ de grib skam bya'o// de nas gong gi de rnams dang kun rtsi bzhin du btags la/ mar khu phul do tsam dang bsres la bzhag /gzhan yang tsha ba gsum dang nas bzang po'i phye bre gang tsam nas 'bru thus byas pa phul gang gis sman mar byas la gsog go /de nas bdud rtsi bzhos pa'i bar du snga ma dang 'dra'o// de nas chu grang mo phul do tsam du tsha ba gsum dang phye en re btab la/ byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la btung ngo*// de'i gong du zhun mar khem bu gang dang*/ nas rdog lnga'am bdun gyur mid btang ngo*// chu yang chu yog thang dus med do// ma 'byongs bar du bzlas brjod mi bya/ gsol ba gdab/ lha'i don la ma yengs par bya/ rlung bcun pa btub/ rlung bskyil ba la sogs pas mi 'ong*/ shed mi 'chag /nang rgyun chad pa dang srin thon/ ma thon par nang du skams nas slar la yags (10ba)pa yin/ bcu gcig nas lus yang du 'gro /shed skye/ shes pa gsal/ dam tshig dang spyod lam sngar dang 'dra'o// zla ba gnyis nas rtsam pa tshwa la sogs pa rgyun gcod/ 'o ma dang ja chang la sogs pa dang po nas yod kyang mi sto/ yon tan gong dang 'dra'o// chu 'dril nas rgyam tshwa la sogs pa tshwa sna btang*/ dri ma thon na a ru ra mchu snyung zhig brdungs te chu bskol la btab la btang*/ 'bri mog rtsi dang*/ rkang dmar dang*/ 'o ma btang na gzi mdangs yod/ nas bzang mo btso ste/ skam skod spru ste/ skams la rtsi bzhin du btags te/ chu kha 'gyur tsa na btab nas rdor bzang du 'jug /de skom la ltog chu tsam btang ngo*// grang 'thung gi gdams pa'i dmigs pa ni/ sngon du tshogs dang gtor mas mkha' 'gro mchod pas bla ma la lung nod pa ni gdams pa yin/

dang po sems bskyed pa spyi dang mthun/ gsang sngags pa yi dam lha'i nga rgyal bya/ tha mal yin na mi dgos/ lha'am tha mal de'i khong rdza ma stong par bsam/ de'i dbus su snying ka'i tshad tsam du/ hūṃ sa raṃ gyi rtsi lta bur bsam/ de gyur pa las sman gyi lha mo 'od ljang ma/ sku mdog dkar mo gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol lhu gu/ phyag g.yas na ral gri/ g.yon na bdud rtsi ro brgya dang ldan pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ 'gying bag dang bcas pa bsams la/ de'i mdun du blo snying gyen la bzlog la snying dkar nag mtshams su ral gri brgyabs nas bcad pas/ snying la rtsa lnga gnas pa la nyon mongs pa lnga 'byung ba yin pas de bcad par bsam/ snying dum bu khog stong gi nang du/ phyag g.yon pa'i bdud rtsi (11na)blugs pas gang nas/ lus thams cad khengs par bsam/ steng rlung 'og rlung kha sbyor du bsgom/ thun gsum mam bzhi'i sbyor bas bsgom/ dmigs pa gsal ba gal che/ de ma gsal na bdud rtsi las 'od 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang gi nad dang gnod pa dang*/ sdig pa dang*/ gdon dang*/ rnam smin gyi lus thul gyis tshig par bsam/ de 'dra'i spro bsdu yang yang bya'o// de ltar byas kyin rtsa ba rgyud gcod/ dang po srin bshal byed pa gal che'o// 'di bsgom na lce thog tu bdud rtsi dkar nyang gis yod par 'dug go// /
